description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package. It provides an extension mechanism for signal enrichment within the context of connectivity, utilizing Akka actors and configurations to dynamically load provider implementations that supply SignalEnrichmentFacade instances based on connection IDs.

classes.name: ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a plugin extension point for providing signal enrichment capabilities based on connectivity, to be loaded via reflection, with methods to obtain facade instances for specific connection IDs.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a SignalEnrichmentFacade instance for a given ConnectionId.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an instance of ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider for a given ActorSystem.
